data.reason: Selected CPM-SDSK-3441S-RLN as the cheapest NEMA 34 SDSK model meeting both torque requirements at 48 VDC (Cont. RMS Torque 479 oz-in >= 492 oz-in? No — 479 < 492, Peak Torque 1,807 oz-in >= 584 oz-in). Re-evaluating: No NEMA 34 SDSK model meets BOTH Cont. (RMS) Torque >= 492 oz-in AND Peak Torque >= 584 oz-in at 48 VDC. The highest Cont. (RMS) Torque among NEMA 34 SDSK models at 48 VDC is 479 oz-in (shared by CPM-SDSK-3411D/P/S-RLN, CPM-SDSK-3421S-RLN, CPM-SDSK-3432S-RLN, CPM-SDSK-3441D/P/S-RLN). CPM-SDSK-3441S-RLN was selected (price $452) as one of the models with the highest Cont. (RMS) Torque.
